definition: Olivier Dominique Faugeras (born 1949) is a French computer scientist and director of research at Inria Sophia Antipolis.
details: He is a member of the French Academy of Sciences and the French Academy of Technologies, and recipient of the 2014 Okawa Prize for his pioneering contributions to computer vision and computational neuroscience.

explainer.lead: Olivier Faugeras is a French computer scientist. His work spans computer vision.

timeline.what: He graduated in mathematics and physics from the École Polytechnique in 1971 and attended the École Nationale Supérieure des Télécommunications for his masters in electrical engineering in 1973.
He then attended the University of Utah for his PhD in computer science and graduated in 1976.
He then became a junior scientist at Inria Rocquencourt until 1979.
